title.narrative: Improved Fiscal And Infrastracture Management Program

description.narrative: The TA is a response to the government's request to address three specific reform gaps articulated under phase 4 of the PRM, building on earlier reforms supported by ADB. The implementation of these reforms will be anchored to ADB's pipeline policy-based operations. The reform areas are: i) Strengthening procurement compliance; ii) Strengthening public enterprise performance and management; and iii) Strengthening resilience through updated building codes.
